summary: Apply behavioural science and nudge design to real organisational challenges. Learn COM-B, EAST, and experimentation tools in this 5-day advanced course.
lede: Behavioural science and nudge design help experienced organisational professionals understand why employees or customers do not take desired actions and shape practical interventions. This course covers behavioural diagnosis, nudge design using frameworks such as COM-B and EAST, and testing interventions through A/B tests or field trials. It also addresses measuring behaviour with KPIs and analytics, and applying ethical safeguards when embedding nudges in organisational workflows.
audienceIntro: This advanced programme is for experienced professionals who already work with behaviour-related challenges and need to apply behavioural science and nudge techniques to complex organisational contexts. Behavioural Insights Lead responsible for organisation-wide behaviour change programmes and pilots. Organisational Development Manager shaping culture, habits, and daily routines across teams. HR Business Partner designing performance, benefits, and people policies that depend on behaviour. Learning and Development Manager embedding nudges into leadership development and skill programmes. Customer Experience Strategist mapping journeys and friction points in service or product use. Product Manager integrating behavioural design into digital features, choices, and notifications. Change Management Consultant crafting adoption strategies for new systems, policies, or processes. Public Policy or Programme Manager designing behaviour-dependent interventions and citizen engagement. Marketing or Communications Lead responsible for campaigns that rely on behaviour shifts, not just awareness. Data or Insight Analyst supporting experimentation, behavioural metrics, and nudge performance reporting.
outcomes: A/B Test and Field Trial Design
modules: Designing Nudges with the EAST Framework
Digital Nudging and AI-Assisted Behavioural Design
Experimentation, A/B Testing, and Field Trials
Scaling Behavioural Interventions Across the Organisation
Ethics, Governance, and Responsible Nudge Practice
Behavioural Impact Measurement and Reporting to Leaders
prerequisites: This is an advanced course. You should have prior exposure to basic behavioural economics or psychology concepts (e.g., loss aversion, social norms, default effects) and at least two years of experience working on organisational change, product design, policy implementation, customer experience, or HR/learning initiatives. Experience commissioning or interpreting data from surveys, A/B tests, or operational dashboards is helpful but not essential. No coding is required; analytical concepts are taught at conceptual and operational application levels, with data analysis demonstrated using accessible tools such as spreadsheets and standard analytics dashboards. You should bring at least one real behavioural challenge from your organisation to use throughout the exercises.
